At Toyota Material Handling Europe, we create the technology that keeps the world moving. With over 13,500 colleagues, we are passionate about supporting companies of all sizes in meeting today's and tomorrow's material handling challenges. We recognize that our industry is essential-and often critical-to everyday life and society as a whole. 

From our headquarters in Mjölby (Sweden) and Willebroek (Belgium), to our sales companies across Europe and our factories in France, Italy, and Sweden, you can be part of an extraordinary journey. Together, we are moving the world towards easier, more sustainable solutions. 

The Position 
As an Industrial Designer at Toyota Material Handling Europe's Design Center, you will shape the future of our products by developing market-leading designs across our portfolio while contributing to advanced concepts and future logistic solutions. You will transform insights, ideas, and technical requirements into compelling products that reflect the Toyota brand and deliver strong commercial value. Working closely with engineering teams, project managers, suppliers, and other key stakeholders, you will balance design excellence with functionality, manufacturability, and business objectives. 
Your responsibility 
Product Design & Development: Create and develop design concepts into feasible product solutions and detailed designs. Ensure products are functional and intuitive based on user needs and requirements. 
Design Implementation: Evaluate concepts through digital models and mock-ups, present proposals, and support engineering implementation. 
Brand & Design Identity: Maintain a consistent design language and contribute to naming and graphics. 
Project Coordination & Collaboration: Lead design activities and align stakeholders across functions and departments. 
Design Research: Monitor trends, competitors, materials, and technologies while supporting production, cost, and commercial considerations.
We are looking for a creative, driven, and passionate Designer with a genuine love for design and innovation. You are excited by the opportunity to shape future products, create compelling design solutions, and bring ideas to life through strong form, detail, and craftsmanship. A Bachelor of Fine Arts (BFA), Master of Fine Arts (MFA), or equivalent degree in Industrial Design, Transportation Design, Product Design, or a related discipline is required. In addition, you bring at least 3 years of professional design experience, with a proven ability to develop products from concept to production. Experience in automotive interior design or a similar field is considered a strong advantage.
We believe you bring: 
Strong skills in Alias, Adobe Creative Suite, and both hand and digital sketching. Able to translate ideas into compelling design concepts through sketching, rendering, and 3D visualization.
Good knowledge of engineering principles, materials, manufacturing processes, and product development. 
Analytical and innovative, with the ability to transform user needs and market insights into relevant design solutions while balancing aesthetics, functionality, feasibility, and cost. 
Strong presentation and communication skills, with the ability to drive design projects and collaborate effectively in an international, cross-functional environment. 
 
Fluent English is required.
Our Offer 
At Toyota Material Handling Europe, we're more than a global leader in a fast-paced industry-we're a collaborative team driven by innovation, continuous growth, and creating real value for our customers. Our diverse and international environment offers a workplace where your ideas are valued, and your contributions can make a meaningful impact. This position is based at our Design Studio in Mjölby, Sweden, with the opportunity to work in a hybrid arrangement, combining on-site and remote work.

At Toyota Material Handling Europe, we are committed to continuous learning and offer good opportunities to develop new skills and take on engaging projects. Collaboration is central to our way of working, and we take pride in fostering a supportive and open environment where every voice is valued.

Time for you to make a MOVE!
Your Application 
Submit your application in English no later than the 6th of December 2026. Applications are only accepted through our recruitment system. We screen continuously, so do not miss out and send in your application today! Please note that a portfolio is mandatory for all applications. Only candidates who submit a portfolio together with their application will be considered and reviewed. 
For more information, please contact Talent Acquisition Specialist Patrik Schultzén at patrik.schultzen@toyota-industries.eu.

jobs.employer_name: Internationella Engelska Skolan i Sverige AB
jobs.description:
Lärare i NO åk 4-9 vikariat under vårterminen 2027,

 40% NO 4-9 möjlighet till förlängning - finns även möjlighet att kombindera med ca 20-40% matematik om så önskas.

Vill du jobba i en internationell miljö med tydlig pedagogisk vision? 

Internationella engelska skolan har gjort stor skillnad för våra elever i 30 år. Vi är övertygade om att det är tack vare vårt tydliga etos med engagerad och närvarande lärare som våra skolor har en miljö där alla arbetar mot gemensamma mål. Vi har en stark kultur som bygger på beprövade rutiner. Hos oss får lärare fokus på undervisning och lärande. Eleverna står i centrum och alla elever är våra elever.

På Internationella engelska skolan är vi ett team som drar åt samma håll. För att tycka om att jobba hos oss bör du dela vår övertygelse om vikten av tydliga värderingar, kollegialt lärande och gemensamma rutiner och förhållningssätt.   

IES är stolta över sina medarbetare och har tagit fram en metod för att skapa en lugn och trygg skolmiljö. Detta gör att våra lärare får mer tid till att dela sin kunskap, både med elever och kollegor. Din egen undervisning sker på svenska men kollegor emellan talar vi engelska. 

Vi söker nu en legitimerad lärare i NO för ett vikariat under VT 2027, möjlighet till förlängning finns och möjlighet att kombinera med matematik finns om man önskar t.ex 60-80% tjänst.

Tjänsten är på heltid. Provanställning tillämpas de första 6 månaderna. 

Tjänstebeskrivning

Arbeta som lärare i åk 4-9.

 Du ingår i ett arbetslag med lärare 4-9 och i ett ämneslag i NO. I ditt arbete ingår att planera, genomföra och följa upp din undervisning utifrån LGR22. Du har även ett mentorskap vilket innebär att du har ett övergripande ansvar för elevernas kunskapsutveckling. Du har en nära dialog med elevernas vårdnadshavare och genomför utvecklingssamtal.  

Vi söker dig som vill vara med och göra skillnad för eleverna i deras livslånga lärande. Vår verksamhet genomsyras av ett positivt synsätt och vi har en stark tilltro till elevernas förmåga. En stark värdegrund och positiv elevsyn är mycket viktig för oss. Tillsammans med dina kollegor arbetar du för att skapa en trygghet, strukturerad, utvecklande och stimulerande lärmiljö för eleverna. Du arbetar tillsammans i team med lärarkollegor, stödpedagoger och fritidspersonal. Vårt uppdrag är att tillsammans leda och stötta eleverna i deras sociala och kunskapsmässiga utveckling. I teamet hjälps pedagogerna åt med planering, undervisning och elevernas skoldag. 

Vem är du?

Du har svensk lärarexamen med behörighet i alla 4 NO ämnen, samt svensk lärarlegitimation. Du har en klar pedagogisk insikt och förmåga att sätta läroplanens mål i ditt arbete. Du har ett tydligt ledarskap och står starkt i dina elevgrupper. Du är flexibel, strukturerad och väl förberedd. Du är en närvarande och medforskande pedagog som utmanar och stimulerar eleverna till utveckling. En stark tro på samarbete som en framgångsfaktor för den pedagogiska utvecklingen, är en självklarhet för dig. 

Du har en rak och ödmjuk kommunikation med vårdnadshavare och skapar tillitsfulla relationer till elever, vårdnadshavare samt kollegor. 

Du bör vara positiv och samarbetsvillig och beredd på att ingå i ett internationellt team.  

I din roll undervisar du på svenska och engelska. Kollegor emellan pratar vi svenska och engelska.

För mer information om vår skola, vänligen se https://engelska.se/our-schools/linkoping/

Vi ser fram emot din ansökan vilken du sänder till recruitment.linkoping@engelska.se 

Glöm inte att bifoga CV, personligt brev och din lärarlegitimation. Märk ansökan med ”Lärare NO 4-9 vik VT27”.

Intervjuer kommer att ske löpande och tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan ansökningstiden gått ut, så skickas i din ansökan redan idag. Utdrag ur belastningsregistret uppvisas vid intervjuer.

Internationella Engelska Skolan (IES) is a leading independent school group with academic results far above average and a diverse and energetic staff. Teaching is in both Swedish and English, and the hallways are bilingual. The language of meetings and communication amongst the staff is English.

IES is one of Sweden's largest school groups at compulsory school level with 46 schools and around 30,000 students across the country. IES has grown steadily and maintained quality since 1993.

N.B. Prior to any offer of employment at IES, a criminal background check is required for all applicants. In Sweden, this is an extract from belastningsregistret from Polismyndigheten and from abroad, this is a record extract from an equivalent police governing body.

With operations across Europe, North America, and the Asia-Pacific region, HOCHTIEF combines engineering expertise with innovative and sustainable solutions to shape the infrastructure of the future.
We are currently looking for a collaborative Environmental Coordinator to join the OL31 railway project in Vagnhärad. This is a role within one of Sweden's most important infrastructure projects, where safety, coordination and collaboration are critical to success.
About the Project
The OL31 Project forms part of the Ostlänken programme, one of Sweden's largest and most important railway infrastructure investments. Ostlänken is a new approximately 160-kilometre double-track railway connecting Järna and Linköping, designed to increase capacity, improve regional connectivity and support sustainable transport across Sweden.
The project involves complex civil engineering works, including tunnels, bridges, earthworks and rail infrastructure. Working on OL31 offers the opportunity to contribute to a landmark infrastructure programme while supporting the recruitment and development of a diverse, international project organization.
About the Role
As an Environmental Coordinator, you will support the project organization in the daily management of environmental matters and ensure compliance with project, client, and regulatory environmental requirements. You will act as the environmental team's operational representative within the production organization, providing hands-on support on site and helping to identify, manage, and mitigate environmental risks at an early stage.
Key Responsibilities
·        Conduct regular environmental inspections, site walks, and environmental audits.
·        Provide day-to-day support and guidance to site management and production teams on environmental matters.
·        Monitor compliance with environmental requirements from Trafikverket, authorities, permits, and project procedures.
·        Support and participate in investigations of environmental incidents, deviations, and non-conformities, and follow up on corrective actions.
·        Support production teams with matters related to material and soil mass management.
·        Monitor water management activities, treatment solutions, and environmental protection measures.
·        Ensure compliance with project chemical management requirements and support chemical handling processes.
·        Prepare, maintain, and follow up environmental documentation, records, and reporting.
·        Act as the operational link between the environmental function and the production organization.
·        Promote environmental awareness and best practices across the project.
Your Profile
Mandatory Requirements
·        2-4 years of experience in environmental coordination within construction, civil engineering, infrastructure, or similar projects.
·        Practical experience working closely with production teams on active construction sites.
·        Experience with environmental inspections, soil and material management, water management, and chemical management.
·        Ability to independently identify, manage, and resolve environmental-related issues.
·        Strong communication and collaboration skills.
·        Structured, proactive, and solution-oriented approach to work.
·        Good knowledge of Swedish and English, both written and spoken.
·        Valid Category B driving license.
 Preferred Qualifications
·        Experience working on large-scale infrastructure or railway projects.
·        Knowledge of Swedish environmental legislation and authority requirements.
·        Experience working with environmental permits, compliance monitoring, and contractor environmental management.
·        Experience supporting environmental investigations and corrective action processes.
·        Familiarity with Trafikverket's environmental requirements and project environments.
·        Relevant academic background in Environmental Science, Environmental Engineering, Civil Engineering, or a related field.
Language Requirements
·        Fluent Swedish, preferably native-level or equivalent proficiency.
·        Professional English language skills, both written and spoken.
 We Offer
The opportunity to work on one of Sweden's largest and most complex infrastructure projects.
An international working environment within a leading global construction company.
Long-term project involvement with significant responsibility and influence.
The chance to contribute to the development of critical rail infrastructure in Sweden.
Expected start date: Q1 2027 (January or February).

 
Location
 Vagnhärad, Sweden
Apply
If you have the qualifications, experience, and passion for creating a safe and successful construction environment, we would love to hear from you.
Get in touch with Nicole Granlund nicole.granlund@hochtief.se,
or apply directly at: https://hochtief.se/karriar/ 
Join HOCHTIEF and help build the infrastructure of tomorrow.

jobs.employer_name: Internationella Engelska Skolan i Sverige AB
jobs.description:
Klasslärare för F-3  sökes!

Vill du jobba i en internationell miljö med tydlig pedagogisk vision? 

Internationella engelska skolan har gjort stor skillnad för våra elever i 30 år. Vi är övertygade om att det är tack vare vårt tydliga etos med engagerad och närvarande lärare som våra skolor har en miljö där alla arbetar mot gemensamma mål. Vi har en stark kultur som bygger på beprövade rutiner. Hos oss får lärare fokus på undervisning och lärande. Eleverna står i centrum och alla elever är våra elever.

På Internationella engelska skolan är vi ett team som drar åt samma håll. För att tycka om att jobba hos oss bör du dela vår övertygelse om vikten av tydliga värderingar, kollegialt lärande och gemensamma rutiner och förhållningssätt.   

IES är stolta över sina medarbetare och har tagit fram en metod för att skapa en lugn och trygg skolmiljö. Detta gör att våra lärare får mer tid till att dela sin kunskap, både med elever och kollegor. Din egen undervisning sker på svenska men kollegor emellan talar vi engelska. 

Vi söker nu en legitimerad lärare för åk F- 3.

Tjänsten är på heltid. Tillträde januari 2027, start vårtermin om möjligt. Provanställning tillämpas de första 6 månaderna. 

Tjänstebeskrivning

Arbeta som lärare i förskoleklass -åk 3. Du ingår i ett arbetslag med lärare F-3 och speciallärare samt specialpedagoger och annan personal. I ditt arbete ingår att planera, genomföra och följa upp din undervisning utifrån LGR22. Du har även ett mentorskap vilket innebär att du har ett övergripande ansvar för elevernas kunskapsutveckling. Du har en nära dialog med elevernas vårdnadshavare och genomför utvecklingssamtal.  

Vi söker dig som vill vara med och göra skillnad för eleverna i deras livslånga lärande. Vår verksamhet genomsyras av ett positivt synsätt och vi har en stark tilltro till elevernas förmåga. En stark värdegrund och positiv elevsyn är mycket viktig för oss. Tillsammans med dina kollegor arbetar du för att skapa en trygghet, strukturerad, utvecklande och stimulerande lärmiljö för eleverna. Du arbetar tillsammans i team med lärarkollegor, stödpedagoger och fritidspersonal. Vårt uppdrag är att tillsammans leda och stötta eleverna i deras sociala och kunskapsmässiga utveckling. I teamet hjälps pedagogerna åt med planering, undervisning och elevernas skoldag. 

Vem är du?

Du har svensk lärarexamen med inriktning f-3, samt svensk lärarlegitimation. Du har en klar pedagogisk insikt och förmåga att sätta läroplanens mål i ditt arbete. Du har ett tydligt ledarskap och står starkt i dina elevgrupper. Du är flexibel, strukturerad och väl förberedd. Du är en närvarande och medforskande pedagog som utmanar och stimulerar eleverna till utveckling. En stark tro på samarbete som en framgångsfaktor för den pedagogiska utvecklingen, är en självklarhet för dig. 

Du har en rak och ödmjuk kommunikation med vårdnadshavare och skapar tillitsfulla relationer till elever, vårdnadshavare samt kollegor. 

Du bör vara positiv och samarbetsvillig och beredd på att ingå i ett internationellt team.  

I din roll undervisar du på svenska. Kollegor emellan pratar vi svenska/engelska.

För mer information om vår skola, vänligen se https://engelska.se/our-schools/linkoping/

Vi ser fram emot din ansökan vilken du sänder till recruitment.linkoping@engelska.se Glöm inte att bifoga CV, personligt brev och din lärarlegitimation. Märk ansökan med ”Lärare F-3 VT27”.

Intervjuer kommer att ske löpande och tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan ansökningstiden gått ut, så skickas i din ansökan redan idag. Utdrag ur belastningsregistret uppvisas vid intervjuer.

Internationella Engelska Skolan (IES) is a leading independent school group with academic results far above average and a diverse and energetic staff. Teaching is in both Swedish and English, and the hallways are bilingual. The language of meetings and communication amongst the staff is English.

IES is one of Sweden's largest school groups at compulsory school level with 46 schools and around 30,000 students across the country. IES has grown steadily and maintained quality since 1993.

N.B. Prior to any offer of employment at IES, a criminal background check is required for all applicants. In Sweden, this is an extract from belastningsregistret from Polismyndigheten and from abroad, this is a record extract from an equivalent police governing body.

Do you want to shape trade compliance for a global business while staying close to real deals and day-to-day operations? At Business Area Rock Processing, we’re looking for a Trade Compliance Officer to lead our work across sanctions, customs, global trade and export controls. You combine a strong understanding of international trade compliance with a practical mindset and the confidence to turn complex requirements into effective ways of working. 
About the job 
You own and develop our trade compliance framework in line with Sandvik policies, helping our Divisions translate requirements into practical processes and controls. Working across the business, you combine governance with hands-on support in deals, projects, and operational matters. You report to our Chief Compliance Officer.  
Job responsibilities 
Establish monitoring and controls, support authority audits and represent Rock Processing in Sandvik’s trade compliance network at all levels in the organization. 
Improve trade master data and integrate compliance controls into how we buy, ship and sell, including screening, review and approvals. 
Monitor regulatory developments across the EU, US, UK, China and other markets, and prepare the business for major changes such as the EU Customs Reform. 
Own restricted party screening, conduct trade compliance due diligence and advise on risks, controls, contract clauses, Incoterms and customs matters. 
Support third-party risk activities and M&A. 
Develop and deliver training to internal teams and key partners. 

Location and flexibility 
The position is based in Malmö, Stockholm or Sandviken, Sweden. Other Sandvik locations in Europe may also be considered. Occasional travel is included in the job. 
Your profile 
You bring extensive experience in trade compliance within an international environment, ideally from an industrial company, and you’re comfortable working across both governance and operational matters. Your expertise covers sanctions, customs and export controls, and you know how to apply complex requirements in a global business. 
Your background includes: 
Solid knowledge of EU and US trade regulations, including customs classification, sanctions management, origin, valuation and Incoterms. 
Experience working with trade processes and data in ERP systems. 
Experience covering sanctions, export controls and customs, from governance through to operational implementation. 
Fluency in English, verbally and in writing. 

Experience with authority audits, licensing and external advisors is an advantage, as is knowledge of anti-bribery and corruption compliance, or data privacy. 
You’re independent and hands-on, with the drive to learn and take on new challenges. With strong integrity and a pragmatic mindset, you know when to stand firm and communicate complex topics clearly across different audiences. You communicate confidently with people at every level of the organization and tailor your message to each audience. 
Our culture 
At Sandvik, we’re tech driven, innovative and entrepreneurial. We believe that success is a team effort so we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive culture where people can be themselves and reach their full potential. So, we invest in supporting each other, learning together and celebrating our differences. Visit our stories hub, LinkedIn or Facebook to get to know us further.

Are you ready to turn machine data into real-time insights that strengthen manufacturing operations worldwide? We’re looking for a hands-on Senior System Engineer with deep expertise in industrial connectivity, automation and IoT to create seamless connections between production equipment and our digital platform. 
 
Here, you get the opportunity to:  
Work with advanced digital solutions and data generated directly from the shop floor. 
Gain broad exposure to global manufacturing technologies and information flows.  
Join a product environment offering varied challenges and opportunities to grow. 

 
About your job 
In this global position, you ensure reliable connectivity between industrial machines at our production units and the digital platform. By collecting, transferring and integrating machine data, you enable real-time analysis, informed decision-making and improved machine performance. 
 
Job responsibilities 

Establish and maintain reliable data connections between industrial machines and the digital platform. 
Implement and troubleshoot connectivity solutions for PLCs, sensors, SCADA systems and other industrial equipment.  
Develop, test and deploy protocols, interfaces and APIs that connect machines with backend systems.  
Integrate machine-generated data with digital platforms and cloud services in collaboration with data engineers and IT teams. 
Diagnose connectivity issues across Ethernet, Modbus and industrial networks, both remotely and on-site.  
Drive connectivity best practices and identify improvements that strengthen data integrity, machine uptime and infrastructure performance. 

 
Location 
This is an on-site position based in Sandviken or Gimo in Sweden or Pune in India. As close collaboration with production is essential, you need to be located near one of these manufacturing sites.  
 
Your profile 
You’re an experienced engineer with a strong background in machine connectivity, industrial automation or IoT. Combining broad technical knowledge with a hands-on approach, you independently drive connectivity activities across a global manufacturing environment. 
 
Your background includes 
A bachelor’s degree om electronics and communication engineering, instrumentation, computer science or a related field.  
Extensive experience in machine connectivity, industrial automation or IoT. 
Hands-on knowledge of Modbus, OPC UA, MQTT, RESTful APIs and protocol converters or gateways. 
Experience with industrial systems such as PLCs, SCADA, DCS and sensors, as well as computer networks and TCP/IP. 
Experience with cloud platforms and data integration tools, such as Azure. 
Strong communication skills in English.  

 
A master’s degree is beneficial. Knowledge of Docker, Kubernetes, cybersecurity, Jenkins, Jira or databases such as SQL Server, Redis, NoSQL or DB2 is also considered an advantage.  
 
Taking ownership comes naturally to you, and you’re comfortable guiding others within your area of expertise. With patience and curiosity, you ask the right questions, understand stakeholder requirements and work through complex technical issues. Clear communication helps you collaborate across functions, segments and production units while keeping data flowing accurately and reliably. 
 
Our culture 
Innovation is in our DNA and we’re proud to shape the future of manufacturing in close collaboration with our customers and partners. We believe in an inclusive, equal and open-minded culture, and we nurture our diversities to form a solid foundation for achieving great results. Add fair and rewarding benefits, as well as many different career opportunities in an inspiring global environment. Meet some of your future colleagues at our career page or visit our website, LinkedIn or Facebook page to get to know us further.

jobs.description:
Reports to: Middle School Principal

Job Description
Teacher for Swedish Language and Literature for Middle Years Programme, grades 6 - 9. This is a Permanent part-time position (60%).  
Our vision
To be recognised as a leading international school that inspires and educates generations of global change-makers. 	
Our mission
Stockholm International School inspires and educates children of the global community through internationally recognised learning programs. We enable international mobility and support growth and talent development in the Stockholm region and beyond. 

Duties/Responsibilities:
A teacher is responsible for the preparation, instruction and follow-up involved in teaching the designated curricula. 
A teacher also has the following duties and areas of responsibility:
● The academic, personal and social welfare of students
● Assessing learning and grading all students in relation to the curricula
● Collaborate with Language B and Language A Teachers on placement tests and transition policies.
● Informing parents with regard to academic and social questions
● Actively participating in Parent/ Teacher/Student conferences
● Comfortable with the use of technology in the classroom, for example the use of ManageBac, Google Classroom, Seesaw, etc
● Ensuring that student attendance is checked and recorded in accordance with the security regulations of the school
● Attending and taking part in planned meetings set by the school and or leadership.
● Attending other meetings called with 2 weeks’ notice
● Being an advisor/mentor for projects e.g. Personal Project (MYP) 
● Learning and Incorporating Positive Discipline practices both in and out of the classroom
● Serving as Homeroom teacher, or Advisory teacher* when appointed/elected. 
● Acting as leaders for Sport/outdoor events during directed working time 
● Being available for school trips or learning outside of school. 
● Actively contributing to teams, committees and task forces.
● Contributing to the development, documentation and implementation of curriculum.
● Participating in Professional Development
● Upholding the Child Protection measures implemented at school

Qualifications and Experience: 
● Be familiar with IBMYP curricula or and equivalent international curricula
● Fluent in written and spoken English and Swedish
● Have excellent communication skills
● Be able to establish rapport with adults and students
● Be able to work effectively in a team
● Be able to function effectively under pressure
● Perform their duties conscientiously
● Be able to show initiative and work independently
● Have a pleasant and friendly personality
● Preferred qualification to teach other disciplines

At Stockholm International School we are committed to protecting children. Aligned with the recommendations of the International Task Force on Child Protection, we hold ourselves to a high standard of effective recruiting practices with specific attention to child protection. All applicants will therefore be required to undergo appropriate child protection screening. Included in the recruitment process will be a local and national police check as well as a mandatory police background check from the last 10 years of employment in every country worked. A judicial background check will be conducted prior to the issuance of the contract for prospective candidates applying to work at our school.

What we offer:
As well as the exciting opportunities this role presents, we also offer benefits in terms of; a pension scheme (Alecta ITP 1/ITP2), a generous wellness stipend, other insurances, and a substantial amount of professional development opportunities inside and outside the school. We also offer staff events and social gatherings that bring colleagues together, for example, hobby evenings and choir practices. Our location in central Stockholm is easily accessible by public transportation. 
Contract: Part-time (60%) (Posibility of more time if the candidate is willing teach Swedish in the Primary 20%) 
Permanent Contract (with a 6-months probationary period) 
Salary: Fixed salary (salary scale)
Starting: January 7, 2027

Application: 
Last day for applications December 6, 2026 (the interview process can start earlier). Please note that, in order to work at SIS, you must hold a valid work permit or be an EU citizen. SIS reserves the right to close the application process at any time once a suitable candidate is found and accepts the position. We only accept applications in English and from qualified teachers. Please send a letter of interest, your CV and two references to application@intsch.se. Mark the email with “Secondary Swedish MYP Teacher”.

jobs.occupation: Product Development Project Manager  Supplier Risk & Crisis - Automotive
jobs.description:
🚀 We’re Hiring: Senior Product Development Project Manager – Supplier Risk & Crisis Management
Company: Hykmann Global Business Solutions AB
Role: Senior Product Development Project Manager / Supplier Risk Leader
Specialisation: Automotive Product Development | Supplier Risk Management | Crisis Management | Project Leadership | Stakeholder Management
Seniority: Senior
Location: Gothenburg, Sweden
Language: Fluent English (spoken and written)
Type: IT Consulting Assignment
About the Role
Hykmann Global Business Solutions AB is looking for an experienced Senior Product Development Project Manager to take responsibility for supplier risk management and crisis coordination within a complex automotive product development environment.
In this role, you will work closely with product owners, project leaders and senior engineering stakeholders to identify potential supplier-related risks at an early stage, coordinate appropriate actions and ensure minimal disruption to product development activities.
You will play a key role in managing critical situations, driving cross-functional collaboration and improving processes related to supplier risk identification, escalation and crisis management.
Key Responsibilities
1. Supplier Risk & Crisis Management
Identify, assess and proactively manage supplier-related risks affecting product development activities.
Monitor early risk indicators and initiate appropriate actions to prevent potential disruptions.
Coordinate crisis management activities and ensure timely responses to critical situations.
Prepare risk-related cases and support decisions on appropriate actions and next steps.
Ensure relevant resources are engaged and stakeholders are informed.
Guide engineering and product development teams through challenging supplier-related situations.

2. Project & Stakeholder Coordination
Collaborate closely with project leaders, crisis management teams and product owners.
Maintain regular communication with product owners to anticipate potential issues and identify effective solutions.
Coordinate risk-related activities across different product development organizations.
Facilitate discussions and ensure alignment between engineering teams and senior stakeholders.
Support effective decision-making and ensure clear ownership of actions.
Communicate risks, priorities and recommended actions to relevant stakeholders.

3. Risk Assessment & Decision Support
Analyse supplier-related challenges and evaluate their potential impact on product development.
Prepare decision-making material and recommend appropriate courses of action.
Ensure the right technical and organizational resources are involved in resolving issues.
Support prioritization of activities based on business impact, urgency and operational requirements.
Drive issues towards resolution through structured follow-up and coordination.

4. Process Improvement & Leadership
Develop and improve working methods for supplier risk and crisis management.
Identify opportunities to improve risk identification, escalation and communication processes.
Promote proactive risk management practices across engineering and project teams.
Share knowledge and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives.
Support efficient collaboration between product owners, project management and engineering organizations.

Required Skills & Experience
Degree in Engineering or an equivalent technical qualification.
Professional experience in automotive product development.
Previous experience in project management or a strong understanding of project management processes.
Good understanding of supplier-related risks and their impact on product development.
Strong stakeholder management and networking capabilities.
Experience coordinating cross-functional teams and complex engineering activities.
Excellent communication and presentation skills.
Experience interacting with senior management and decision-makers.
Strong analytical, problem-solving and decision-making capabilities.
Ability to manage multiple priorities and respond effectively to challenging situations.
Fluent in English, both spoken and written.

What We’re Looking For
We are looking for a dynamic, flexible and decisive professional who can proactively identify risks, bring stakeholders together and drive effective solutions.
The ideal candidate should have strong leadership and communication skills, with the ability to navigate complex organizational structures and build effective professional networks.
You should be comfortable handling challenging situations, facilitating discussions with senior stakeholders and ensuring that critical issues receive timely attention.
A proactive mindset, sound judgement and the ability to turn potential risks into structured actions are essential for success in this role.
Interested in This Opportunity?
Are you an experienced automotive project management professional with strong supplier risk management, crisis coordination and stakeholder leadership skills?
We would be happy to hear from you!
Apply directly through our careers page:
🌐 https://www.hykmann.com/careers
Company: Hykmann Global Business Solutions AB
🌐 https://hykmann.com
The recruitment process is managed by Hykmann Global Business Solutions AB. Please direct any questions regarding this opportunity to us.
